    How to ride
    • SteerPoint the mouse where you want to go: to either side turns, up tucks (faster), down stands tall (slower). Arrow keys work too.Hold a finger on the picture: to either side turns, up tucks (faster), down stands tall (slower).
    • Brake & turn roundHold Shift or the mouse button to brake; X or a right-click turns you round to ride switch.Hold Brake to slow down; 180 turns you round to ride switch.
    • KickersRide at a jump and the stance you leave it in is your trick: tucked, a ski jumper's flight; standing tall, a backflip; turning, a spin. Land pointing downhill, or you fall and the run restarts.
    • The endRide on to the blue line and flags at the foot of the run to finish. Your points and best time are kept in this browser.
    • MoreH or Esc opens the menu, M the map of the runs, Enter starts the run again.The Menu button has the map of the runs, the skier and the settings.
